option_relations.rationale: Central Retinal Vein Occlusion (CRVO) is a specific type of retinal vein occlusion
Macular retinal vein occlusion with chronic cystoid macular edema is a specific type of retinal vein occlusion with associated cystoid macular edema
Branch Retinal Vein Occlusion (BRVO) is a type of retinal vein occlusion, but the provided information does not specifically suggest BRVO
Retinal vein occlusion is a broader term that encompasses various types of retinal vein occlusions, including CRVO
